status: The assertions define the selected design. Embedded result states describe the initial baseline. The ignored verification workspace stores current execution results.
input_rules: Each case starts with the base. Explicit operation inputs override the base. The set map uses dotted card paths. Each case uses an isolated store.
projection_rules: Each expect object defines the exact fields and types that the adapter must return. The report retains full raw results separately.
limits: The fixture_units counter tests context allocation only. It does not test real tokenization. Source and plugin limits in individual cases override production defaults.
reference_rules: Each upstream result remains independent. Related observations do not establish complete workflow results. The report must retain deliberate differences.
